entries.title: misode 26.4-snapshot-1 technical changes
entries.summary: pack breaking obsolete | Data pack format has been increased to 122.0.

metadata.preview:
pack breaking obsolete | Data pack format has been increased to 122.0.

pack breaking obsolete | Resource pack format has been increased to 98.0.

network | Added C2S packet mod_list, which empty in vanilla but allowed modded platforms to send information to the server.

network | Modified C2S packet intention. Modified the format of the host field.

network | Modified S2C packet transfer. Added field properties.

options | Added allowed-connection-ids option to the server.properties file, which is a list of comma-separated IDs.

options | Added status-contact-details option to the server.properties file. Meant as a human-readable value which will be sent in the status_response packet JSON payload under the contact property.

options | Added enable-legacy-status option to the server.properties file. Defaults to true.

debug | Removed debug properties -DMC_DEBUG_ORE_VEINS, -DMC_DEBUG_AQUIFERS, and -DMC_DEBUG_DISABLE_ORE_VEINS.

command breaking | The /fillbiome command will now fill biomes with block accuracy.

worldgen | Changed tree feature trunk placer straight_trunk_placer: added trunk_width field, which is an int provider defaulting to 1.

entries.title: misode 26.4-snapshot-2 technical changes
entries.summary: pack breaking | Data pack format has been increased to 122.1.

metadata.preview:
pack breaking | Data pack format has been increased to 122.1.

pack breaking | Resource pack format has been increased to 99.0.

environment-attribute | Added visual/has_sky_occluder environment attribute to control fog color when camera is not submerged. Format: boolean, defaults to false. Determines whether the sky occluder is enabled for the environment. The sky occluder will occlude the sky box up until a certain angle with fog color with a smooth occlusion border.

worldgen | Added below_heightmap worldgen block predicate. It has one field heightmap, the heightmap type to compare against.
